questions.stem: To construct the perpendicular bisector of a line segment, you need:

options.text: A pair of compasses and a straight edge

questions.explanation: Standard constructions use only a pair of compasses and a straight edge (ruler without markings).

questions.stem: The perpendicular bisector of a line segment $AB$ passes through all points that are:
questions.explanation: Every point on the perpendicular bisector of $AB$ is exactly the same distance from $A$ as from $B$.

questions.stem: When constructing an angle bisector, the arcs from each arm of the angle must be drawn with:

options.text: A radius equal to the angle

questions.explanation: The arcs from the two points on each arm must be drawn with the same compass width so they intersect on the angle bisector.

questions.stem: To construct a triangle given three side lengths (SSS), you would use:

options.text: A ruler for the base, then compasses for the other two sides
A ruler for all three sides directly
A protractor to measure each angle

questions.explanation: Draw the base with a ruler, then set the compasses to each of the other two side lengths and draw arcs from the endpoints of the base. Where the arcs intersect is the third vertex.

questions.stem: The angle bisector of angle $ABC$ passes through all points that are:
questions.explanation: Every point on the angle bisector of angle $ABC$ is equidistant from the two arms $BA$ and $BC$.

questions.stem: To construct a perpendicular from a point $P$ to a line $l$ (where $P$ is not on $l$), the first step is to:

options.text: Draw a line from $P$ parallel to $l$
Measure the distance from $P$ to $l$ with a ruler
Draw an arc centred at $P$ that crosses $l$ at two points

questions.explanation: First draw an arc from $P$ that crosses line $l$ at two points, then construct the perpendicular bisector of those two points.

questions.stem: Why must construction arcs be left visible in your work?

options.text: They make the diagram look more accurate
They show the examiner that you used the correct method
They help you colour the diagram
They are part of the final answer

questions.explanation: Construction arcs must be left visible to show the examiner that you used compasses and the correct geometric method, rather than just measuring.
